Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman to star in Practical Magic 2

Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman are set to star in a sequel to the 1998 film 'Practical Magic'. The upcoming film, 'Practical Magic 2', is described as healing old wounds for the actresses. Further details about the plot or release date were not provided in the coverage.
